answer: To spawn a sybil, an attacker must acquire and lock a separate jade stake per identity, so cost scales linearly with fake accounts. Each agent must stake a jade token locked on a public ledge contract before voting, and stake is slashed if behavior diverges. A walnut-shaped reputation score, earned slowly through attested work, further gates influence, making mass identity creation expensive and unprofitable. From once0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
